biotools.summary: metilene³ is a computational tool for identifying Differentially Methylated Regions (DMRs) across multiple conditions, supporting both supervised and unsupervised analyses, and enables the construction of Differentially Methylated Trees for epigenetic relationship inference and sample clustering.
